//: Easy Auth authsettingsV2 for API/bearer mode (README §4.5). Apply with: az rest --method PUT --uri 'https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/<subscription-id>/resourceGroups/<resource-group>/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/<app-name>/config/authsettingsV2?api-version=2022-03-01' --body @authsettingsv2.example.json  (repeat against .../slots/staging/... for the staging slot). Replace <tenant-id>, <api-app-id>, <client-app-id>, <hostname>. The companion site setting WEBSITE_AUTH_PRM_DEFAULT_WITH_SCOPES=true (see appsettings.example.json) is what turns the 401 into an RFC 9728 PRM challenge.
